_comment: rgas-source config (client SPEC C-33). Copy to config.json next to RgasSoundboard.exe. booth_ip may be left empty - the app warns and offers SCAN (C-34), and a successful scan persists the address here. mode_advance: 'continuous' (auto-advance, loops) or 'single_shot' (stop at track end). default_speaker_mode is the fresh-install output routing ('stream_only' | 'playback_and_stream' | 'playback_only'); the operator's last choice is persisted in the library store and wins (C-32). announcer_api_key (C-42/C-43): paste via the in-app popup - it is stored DPAPI-encrypted per machine/user; an OpenAI key (sk-...) uses announcer_openai_*, an ElevenLabs key (sk_...) uses announcer_elevenlabs_*.
